Card Q&A.a: It refers to any situation where 2 or more cards with the same level are found when looking at all of the stacked cards. Example situations include a level 5 Digimon with a level 5 digivolution card, or a level 6 Digimon with 2 level 5 digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: What situations does "this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards" refer to?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, both have to be XX.For example, "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [CS] trait or that is yellow or black" means either "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [CS] trait" or "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card that is yellow or black." In both cases, the card must be level 4 or lower.
Card Q&A.q: If a text says "XX card with AA or BB," does that mean AA and BB both have to be XX?
